description: A Java class representing configuration settings for a module, including properties such as scheme, host, port, URI, environment, and additional configurations, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: A POJO (Plain Old Java Object) class that encapsulates configuration parameters for a module, providing accessors and mutators for each property.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme (protocol) of the configuration.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme (protocol) of the configuration.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host name or address.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host name or address.

methods.name: getConfig1
methods.description: Returns the first custom configuration value.

methods.name: setConfig1
methods.description: Sets the first custom configuration value.

methods.name: getConfig2
methods.description: Returns the second custom configuration value.

methods.name: setConfig2
methods.description: Sets the second custom configuration value.
